name: brollss
description: Import a video, cut it, zoom, draw scenes, add captions, music and sound effects, then check the edit in Brollss, from your agent.

interface.longDescription: Brollss edits talking-head videos. Import a video from a link or a file, then your assistant reads the transcript, cuts retakes and fillers, opens on the strongest sentence, zooms where it matters, draws animated scenes over or beside the speaker, and adds captions, music and sound effects. It checks its own edit by code and looks at the final picture before it calls the edit finished. The project opens in the Brollss Studio, where you review it and export.
defaultPrompt: Import this video into Brollss and make a clean, publishable edit
Cut the retakes and fillers in my latest Brollss project
Review the edit of my Brollss project and list what to fix
